EA-04.original_form: Small releases, short increments and frequent delivery.
EA-04.mechanism: Reduce the unit of build, integration or exposure until marginal learning/reversal benefit no longer exceeds transaction and qualification cost.
EA-04.mature_form: Use the smallest coherent batch justified by total economics and consequence.

EA-04.criticism: Small batches are not intrinsically cheap and may not correspond to a useful or qualifiable increment.
